fields.climate: tropical; warm and comparatively dry along southeast coast; hot and humid in southwest; hot and dry in north
fields.terrain: mostly low plains with dissected plateau in south-central area
fields.hazards: dry, dusty, northeastern harmattan winds from January to March; droughts
fields.resources: gold, timber, industrial diamonds, bauxite, manganese, fish, rubber, hydropower, petroleum, silver, salt, limestone
fields.farm: cassava, yams, plantains, maize, oil palm fruit, taro, rice, oranges, pineapples, cocoa beans
fields.exports: gold, crude petroleum, cocoa beans, manganese ore, cocoa paste
fields.industries: mining, lumbering, light manufacturing, aluminum smelting, food processing, cement, small commercial ship building, petroleum
fields.languages: Asante 16%, Ewe 14%, Fante 11.6%, Boron (Brong) 4.9%, Dagomba 4.4%, Dangme 4.2%, Dagarte (Dagaba) 3.9%, Kokomba 3.5%, Akyem 3.2%, Ga 3.1%, other 31.2%
fields.religions: Christian 71.3% (Pentecostal/Charismatic 31.6%, Protestant 17.4%, Catholic 10%, other 12.3%), Muslim 19.9%, traditionalist 3.2%, other 4.5%, none 1.1%
fields.legal: mixed system of English common law and customary law
fields.military: 18-27 years of age for voluntary military service; no conscription
